pkgmetadata.longdescription: Magpie is a local gateway and model switcher for coding agents. It points Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents at any model provider from one place, and switches models, routes requests, tracks usage and quota, and manages provider keys through a menu bar app, a TUI, a browser UI or the CLI.
Magpie 是面向编程代理的本地网关与模型切换器：在一个地方为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等代理指定任意模型提供方，并提供菜单栏应 用、TUI、浏览器界面和 CLI 来切换模型、路由请求、跟踪用量与配额、 管理提供方密钥。

use.flag: Build the desktop menu bar application, which links GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1. Without this flag only the headless CLI, TUI and web binary (magpie-cli) is installed.
